seed_ledger.name: Pecos power plant (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: sources show this is a grid plant, not a data center plant. TCEQ notice for permit 181523 (Pecos Power Plant LLC, 24 Wartsila engines, 4200 S Tolivar Street, Pecos, Reeves County) says it sells electricity to the grid, and Mercuria and Continental describe a 452 MW ERCOT reliability plant. No source ties it to the Amazon or Pacifico GW Ranch campus, which is in Pecos County and has its own 15-mile Waha line (existing candidate gw-ranch-waha-gas-pipeline). No gas supply pipe named. Probably should be dropped as a data center lead if GOGPT cannot show the tie. Searches run: 4 (web search budget ran out; Railroad Commission and FERC not searched). Sources checked: TCEQ notice, Mercuria release, Pacifico and Amazon coverage.

evidence.note: permit 181523, power sold to grid, Reeves County
